task: 26-ui-showcase cargo-fail (SEAL): E0277 Send+Sync+static bounds NOT propagated to the polymorphic msg type-param of a Sky function that calls a Std.Ui.Input kernel (inputMultilineFill : (String -> msg) -> Element msg emits fn<T1: Clone> but input_multiline_<M: Clone+Send+Sync+static> requires the bounds). SAME FAMILY as #177 (SkyRow) / #186 (Display): a kernel called on a generic/wildcard type-param needs the trait bound(s) its Rust signature requires propagated to the emitted generic. Best solved by the GENERAL kernel->required-bound propagation.
notes: The general kernel->bound map exists NOW (apply_kernel_type_param_bounds, #186) and is named-tvar-capable, but #184 needs THREE more pieces beyond #186's Shape-A (direct-Var-arg) machinery, verified 2026-07-14: (1) SHAPE B detection: msg does NOT appear as a direct Var arg to the Input kernel; it is the OUTPUT type of the onEdit:(String->msg) callback param passed to input_multiline_. Need a walker that, for each tvar, checks whether a param whose TYPE embeds Generic(tvar) flows (alias-transparently) as an arg into a Send+Sync-requiring kernel -> add Send/Sync/'static. Distinct from body_calls_kernel_on_param's Var-in-arg-position test. (2) RUNTIME SIGNATURE AUDIT: the text/multiline/slider family (input_text_/email_/username_/search_/currentPassword_/newPassword_/multiline_/slider_/input_base_) OVER-DECLARES M: Clone+Send+Sync+'static — bodies only pass on_change through to ui_on_input_ (which bounds M with NOTHING) and build Element/Attribute<M> (derive Clone, no Sync). M: Clone suffices; relax to Clone (or Clone+Send+'static) like #166 did for sub_subscribe_stream. BUT input_checkbox_/input_radio_/input_radio_row_/radio_core_ GENUINELY need M: Send+Sync (they Arc::new(move || toggle_msg.clone()) capturing an M value into a Send+Sync Arc slot). So the map must be PER-KERNEL, not one flag for the whole family. (3) CTOR-PAYLOAD-FN HOLE (guardian-flagged): a msg enum carrying a Box<dyn Fn> payload (#90) renders Send+'static but NOT Sync (emit_types.rs:280). Emitting an unconditional +Sync on such a named msg tvar would itself be a NEW skyc-0-then-cargo-fail. For the genuinely-Sync-requiring checkbox/radio kernels, Shape B must FAIL-CLOSED at lowering with a diagnostic when the tvar could be non-Sync, not emit an unsatisfiable bound. For the multiline family, relaxing the runtime to Send-only sidesteps the hole entirely (Send IS satisfiable for a ctor-payload-fn enum). Recommended order: (a) relax the text/multiline/slider runtime sigs to M: Clone [+Send+'static if any Send is truly needed]; (b) add Shape B emitting only the bounds each kernel actually requires; (c) for checkbox/radio, decide fail-closed-vs-relax after re-reading whether Sync is load-bearing. #178 fixed CONCRETE-msg Box->Arc; this is the POLYMORPHIC-msg residue.

task: Reused-by-value generic param clone gap (SEAL): a generic/wildcard type-param used MORE THAN ONCE in a BY-VALUE kernel call moves twice -> cargo E0382 (borrow of moved value). Minimal repro: dup x = toString x ++ toString x -> skyc-0, emits fn main_dup<T1: Clone + Display>(x: T1) with basics_to_string(x) TWICE, no .clone() -> E0382. Root cause: clone_class(IrType::Generic(_)) => CloneClass::NonClone (sky_lower/src/lower.rs:828), so the T5 multi-use-clone pass (fires only for CloneOk) skips generic params, AND reject_fn_value_reuse is a no-op for Generic (ir_contains_fun(Generic)=false), so a reused generic silently moves twice. Fix (guardian-approved sound): in the T5 param loop, treat a reused IrType::Generic(tv) as clonable (insert .clone() on all-but-last use) IFF the emitted bound-set for tv includes Clone (it always does for emitted generics) — the T: Clone bound is the gate (a non-Clone Box<dyn Fn> instantiation fails the Clone bound at the caller before the .clone() is reached, so no unsoundness). Single source of truth: the T5 clone-decision and the bound-map's Clone emission must agree.
notes: Filed by #186 agent (2026-07-14). PRE-EXISTING gap (reachable for ANY by-value kernel on a reused generic), NOT introduced by #186 — #186's Display bound merely makes the narrow double-toString instance reachable (before it died at E0277 first). #177's Db.get* reuse does NOT hit this because db_get_* takes &row (borrows). Loud cargo-fail (E0382), never silent-wrong-accept, so it does NOT block #186's SEAL. Guardian ruled: file separately, own commit (touches the T5 generic-clone contract, broader surface than #186's bound map). Consider a distinct CloneClass::GenericCloneBounded variant so 'is this generic clonable' is carried in the type, not re-derived.

task: 38-composite-ui-multibackend cargo-fail (SEAL): E0382 use of moved value 'habit' (concrete non-Copy RecHistoryIdName). The emitter wraps a reused binding as `Arc::new(move |_x| ({ let habit = habit.clone(); Box::new(move |...| ... habit ...) })(_x))` — the INNER `let habit = habit.clone()` sits INSIDE the outer `move` closure, so the outer `move` still captures/moves the ORIGINAL `habit` (the .clone() reads the free outer var under `move`). A later sibling use (StateMsg::RemoveHabit((habit).id)) then hits use-after-move. Root cause: the clone-for-capture must be HOISTED OUTSIDE the `move` closure: `{ let habit = habit.clone(); Arc::new(move |_x| ...) }` so the closure owns the pre-made clone and the original survives for later uses. Interacts with #178's arc_callback_wrap (the Arc wrapper is where the ordering goes wrong). Distinct from #189 (that's GENERIC-param reuse; this is a CONCRETE non-Copy binding captured into a move closure with sibling reuse).
notes: Found by fresh sweep 2026-07-14. Concrete-msg (StateMsg) app. The emitter already hoists correctly for some closures (the day-closure wraps `{ let habit = habit.clone(); {...} }` OUTSIDE) but NOT for the Arc-wrapped input_checkbox callback. Fix the arc_callback_wrap / callback-capture path to hoist the capture-clone outside the Arc move closure. Verify no double-move remains for any reused non-Copy binding.
